properties.name: MEASURED 2026-09-22: the design merge driver resolved a merge correctly but wrote the merged export in a different byte layout from export_graph (unsorted keys, `stamp` first), so a ~115-line design change showed as a ~380,000-line rewrite against main
properties.source: PR #571, merge of origin/main (#570) into fix/shared-attach-by-any-path-spelling via `reflow2-mcp --merge-driver` (worktree debug build of 0.66.0 + the path fix)
properties.statement: OBSERVED merging main (#570) into a fix branch whose only overlap was docs/design/reflow2.json. `git merge` invoked the configured driver (`merge.reflow2.driver = target/debug/reflow2-mcp --merge-driver %O %A %B`) and it resolved the merge CORRECTLY. Verified: all 4 nodes the branch added and all 35 main added were present, every edge from both sides, and nothing from the base lost. But the file it wrote began `{ "stamp": { "reflow2_version": …` with keys unsorted, while export_graph writes sorted keys (`{ "content_hash": …, "edges": [ …`). `git diff --stat origin/main` on the merge commit read "383890 +++++++-----" for the export, a whole-file rewrite, although the real design delta was ~115 lines. Re-importing that file and running export_graph produced the canonical layout, and the diff against main fell to 115 lines; export_graph reported `wrote: unchanged` because the CONTENT was identical, although every byte moved. CONSEQUENCES: (1) a reviewer of the PR cannot see the design change; (2) the next export rewrites the whole file again; (3) `wrote: unchanged` is misleading when bytes change, which is exactly when a committer needs to know. Workaround used: re-import and re-export after every driver merge. Not root-caused; the likely reading is that the driver serialises through a different path from export_graph's canonical writer. A SECOND, SEPARATE observation from the next merge (main at #572): the driver correctly raised exactly 2 conflicts, both on one ChangeEvent written twice under one id (once in the live shared design, once in a branch-private store; see fact:a-worktree-fix-recorded-its-design-changes-in-the-live-store-and-the-branch-gate-failed-2026-09-22), and `--merge-apply` with per-id resolutions worked as documented.
